about: A free, $0-capital crypto signal bot. It sends RSI + MACD confluence alerts to Telegram, paper-tracks every trade, and ships with a backtester, a parameter tuner and an opt-in Binance executor. It only places real orders if you explicitly switch live trading on.

features.title: Confluence, not single signals
features.body: LONG only when RSI recovers from oversold, the MACD histogram flips positive and price is above the 50 EMA (mirrored for SHORT).

features.title: Risk built in
features.body: Stop at 1.5 × ATR, target at 2:1 reward-to-risk, 2% risk per trade on the paper ledger.

features.title: Telegram alerts
features.body: An alert on every signal and every exit.

features.title: No API key for data
features.body: Prices come from Yahoo Finance and work through most corporate proxies.

features.title: Backtest and tune
features.body: A multi-symbol sweep and a grid parameter tuner ship with it.

features.title: You stay in control
features.body: Alerts by default; the Binance executor is opt-in, testnet first, with hard risk caps.
